entries.source: Higher of the last tagged FY2024 capex ($4.8M, FY24 10-K) and the v4 TTM estimate (~$19M), per Andrew's conservative rule (2026-10-13)
entries.reason: AppLovin tags no capex from FY2025 onward under any candidate tag. Tagged capex ran $0.7–4.8M/yr FY19–24 vs OCF in the billions — structurally immaterial; $19M is ~4x the last filed figure and still moves base OE by <0.5%.
